课程简介（中文）

本课程面向全校各专业本科生，从日常生活出发，介绍当前备受关注的新污染物问题——它们是什么、从哪里来、如何影响我们的健康与生活环境。课程将结合生活实例、社会热点与政策动态，生动解读新污染物对人与环境的潜在影响，并探讨个人与社会如何共同应对。通过学习，学生将建立对环境健康问题的基本认识，提升跨学科思维与现实关怀能力。

课程内容注重科普性、现实性与启发性，无需前置专业背景，适合所有感兴趣的同学选修。

课程简介（英文）

This course is designed for undergraduate students from all majors. Starting from daily life, it introduces the currently prominent issue of emerging contaminants—what they are, where they come from, and how they affect our health and living environment. The course will combine real-life examples, social topics, and policy trends to vividly explain the potential impacts of emerging contaminants on humans and the environment, and explore how individuals and society can respond together. Through this course, students will develop a fundamental understanding of environmental health issues and enhance their interdisciplinary thinking and awareness of real-world concerns.

The course content emphasizes accessibility, relevance, and inspiration. No prior professional background is required, making it suitable for all interested students to enroll.

教学目标

本课程旨在使各专业学生掌握新污染物的核心概念、主要类别及其对人群健康的影响机制；了解当前环境健康领域的前沿研究进展与代表性现实案例；并拓宽从环境科学、公共卫生到社会政策等多学科交叉解决实际问题的视野与风险意识。
